months.title: September 2026
months.summary: A big month for telephoto lenses and a quiet one for Nikon. Sony shrank the super-telephoto with a sub-1 kg 400mm f/4.5 and 600mm f/6.3, and added its first full-frame fisheye zoom. Canon finally put IBIS in its cheapest full-frame body with the EOS R8 Mark II. Fujifilm gave X shooters a 400mm f/4.5 prime, and Sigma filled out its E and L lineups with an 85mm f/1.2 and a wide 20-60mm walkaround zoom. OM System revived the PEN name. Nikon only announced products in development: nine cinema lenses built with RED, and firmware 2.0 for the ZR.
months.forYou: Nothing new for your Z7 II this month. Nikon's announcements are development notices only, and the new Sigma lenses are E and L mount.

items.name: EOS R8 Mark II
highlights: 24.2MP full-frame, now with 5-axis IBIS (up to 7.5 stops)
Uncropped 4K 60p oversampled from 6K, 10-bit Canon Log 3
Single UHS-II SD slot, LP-E17 battery, about 546 g

items.name: FE 400mm F4.5 GM OSS
highlights: 994 g without the tripod foot: lightest lens of its kind
95mm front filters, optical stabilization

items.name: FE 600mm F6.3 GM OSS
highlights: Nearly identical in size to the 400mm f/4.5, about 995 g
2.5 m minimum focus, 0.25x magnification, 95mm filters

items.name: FE 8-14mm F3.5 Fisheye G
highlights: Sony's first full-frame fisheye zoom
About 314 g, fluorine-coated front element

items.name: XF 400mm F4.5 R LM OIS WR
highlights: 609mm-equivalent prime for X-mount, about 1,245 g
Up to 5.5 stops of optical stabilization, weather resistant

items.name: 85mm F1.2 DG | Art
highlights: Sony E and L-Mount, 905 g, 82mm filters
Lightest fast 85mm, at roughly half the price of Canon's

items.name: 20-60mm F2.8-4 DG | Contemporary
highlights: Wider-than-usual standard zoom for Sony E and L-Mount
About 385 g, aimed at hybrid photo and video shooters

items.name: OM System PEN
highlights: 20.4MP Micro Four Thirds with 5.5-stop IBIS
Cinema 4K 24p and 4K 30p, BLS-7 battery
items.note: Not in the catalog yet: card slot not confirmed.

items.name: NIKKOR Z CINEMA T1.9 VV lenses
highlights: Nine cinema primes made with RED, starting with a 50mm T1.9
Image circle covers sensors larger than full frame, with autofocus

items.name: Nikon ZR firmware 2.00
highlights: Announced in development, with Open Gate recording coming in 2027

items.name: Aizu Prime Line 21mm, 100mm and 125mm T1.3 LF
highlights: Large-format cinema primes in PL and Sony E mount

items.name: Summicron-M 66mm f/2 (limited edition)
highlights: Modern take on the 1960s Elcan 66mm f/2, 660 units worldwide
